item.title: Path of Exile 2: 0.5.5 Event League & Duelist Deep Dive
item.description:
Play the Forbidden Rites Event on September 4

During GGG Live earlier today, we revealed our next 0.5.5 update for Path of Exile 2, releasing September 4 at 1 PM PDT! This patch introduces the new event league, Forbidden Rites, featuring 8 new challenges and exclusive rewards, as well as a major Trial of Chaos overhaul and more. We’ll post the patch notes next week, closer to the release.

item.title: HOI IV Dev Corner | Romania, an Industry Divided
item.description:
Hello all!

In today's Dev Corner, we're diving into the economic crossroads of Romania. Like many nations in the 1930s, Romania was torn between its agrarian foundation and a push for rapid industrialization. What makes it unique, though, is the sheer scale of this divide, with over 70% of the population tied to rural agriculture,; modernizing the nation is no small feat.
